# Sheets commands a plugin may run

75 of the 344 Sheets registry commands are on the allowlist (docs/plugins.md section 6a). `read` ids need `document = "read"`, every other id `document = "write"`. `params` is the registry's own description of the parameters; a `run` whose params hold a key named `path`, `dir`, `file`, `url`, `uri`, `href` or `src`, or a denied key of the list, is refused.

## `cell.`

| Id | Access | Label | Params |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cell.get` | read | Get Cell | `{cell?, sheet?} → value, formula, display text, style, comment, link` |
| `cell.set` | write | Enter Cell | `{cell?: "B2", input: "text, number or =formula", sheet?, array?: bool}` |
| `cell.toggleCheckbox` | write | Toggle Checkbox | `{cell?}` |

## `document.`

| Id | Access | Label | Params |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document.inspect` | read | Inspect Workbook | `{} → sheets, selection, names, tables, charts, dirty, history` |
